proposals.candidate_label: degree-aware dual-view graph contrast on LightGCN
proposals.expected_signal: Improved frozen full-sort NDCG@10 if a lightweight self-supervised auxiliary stabilizes sparse-user/item embeddings and reduces popularity-skew overfitting without changing the ranking protocol.
proposals.failure_mode: Contrastive regularization can wash out collaborative signal or collapse toward popularity structure, yielding flat or worse NDCG@10 despite better embedding uniformity.
proposals.hypothesis: Adding a degree-aware dual-view contrastive auxiliary to LightGCN will improve ranking quality on ML-1M by making propagated user/item representations more robust for low-degree nodes while preserving the main collaborative ranking objective.
